_comment: Per-region wander rules (2026-10-07). Matched by sim (region) name, case-insensitive. seatAvatarM: skip a seat if any avatar is within this many metres (horizontal, same level). greet: auto-greet people while wandering. levelDwellMin (2026-10-08): home wander minutes on one level (beach or upper) before switching to the other. Unknown regions use 'default'.
